mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forum_post (user_id, section_id, title, content, images, like_count, comment_count, view_count, is_sticky, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sectionId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{images}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{viewCount}, #{isSticky}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE forum_post SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, images = #{images}, status = #{status}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.section_id, p.title, p.content, p.images, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.view_count, p.is_sticky, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.username AS author_username, d.avatar AS author_avatar, s.name AS section_name FROM forum_post p INNER JOIN sys_user u ON p.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN sys_user_detail d ON p.user_id = d.user_id INNER JOIN forum_section s ON p.section_id = s.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
